comment: The conformance model is presented as the model (an ArchiMate-typed formalism). Other valid conformance ecosystems exist (IHE, FHIR IG testing). We recommend presenting §3.7 as a reference model — alternatives acceptable where they meet the objectives and map to the reference, in line with the draft's own "adopt, adapt, or map" language (§3.7.1).

reviewer.organisation: CoWEAVE - Medtronic LABS; eGov Foundation; Open Healthcare Network Foundation

public.text: The conformance model is presented as the model (an ArchiMate-typed formalism). Other valid conformance ecosystems exist (IHE, FHIR IG testing). We recommend presenting §3.7 as a reference model — alternatives acceptable where they meet the objectives and map to the reference, in line with the draft's own "adopt, adapt, or map" language (§3.7.1).
